newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks end up in speculative trade.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks end up in speculative trade.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Wednesday, although trade on the new accounts day was limited to speculative interest in selected blue chips, dealers said.
"Overall the market was bearish," dealer Salman Ahmad of Finex Securities said. Trading interest was limited to a few blue chips only, he added.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 10.55 points, or 0.67 percent, to close at 1,576.36. Losers led gainers 195 to 97.
Pakistan State Oil rose 11 rupees to 275 rupees but PTCL fell 0.15 to 29.40. - Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
